design: paired retrospective review of six historical revisions
selection: Three Fleet Manager PRs and three shipper PRs; varied change areas, excluding tuning PRs 64 and 79; includes two single-commit PRs without substantive historical findings. Purposive, not random.
revision_policy: Earliest revision with an inline review still in PR history. Single-commit head when there is no inline review. Parent/common ancestor with API baseRefOid is baseline.
generic_prompt: Review this PR. Pay attention to regressions, correctness, security, compatibility, code cleanliness, and missing tests. Report actionable issues introduced or materially exposed by this change; give concrete triggers, consequences, file/line references, and priorities. Check the base to distinguish pre-existing issues.
common_constraints: Read only the assigned case base/, head/, change.diff, stat.txt and target.json; read repository governing documents from this snapshot.
No historical comments, later commits, current checkout code, amended PR descriptions, other review outputs, or GitHub history.
Skill-guided arm additionally reads the three frozen component skill files. Existing-thread lookup and PR-description checks are disabled in both arms to prevent answer leakage.
Report findings with P1/P2/P3, title, file, line, trigger/consequence, evidence, and suggested fix. Include tests actually run and limitations. No invented test runs.
No modifications to source snapshots. Reproductions can use a private temporary copy. Do not post to GitHub.
scoring: Freeze historically documented issues before comparing outputs; verify each remains present at the selected head and was introduced or newly exposed relative to base.
Exclude pure stylistic preferences, already-fixed issues, and explicitly disproven review comments from the bug-recall denominator; report useful cleanliness findings separately.
One point per independently actionable root cause, merging duplicate findings. Report historical recovery and adjudicated additional findings separately.
Classify each reported finding as supported defect, supported maintainability issue, false positive, pre-existing, or uncertain. Do not assume no historical comment means false positive.
Report precision only on adjudicated classifications, with uncertain findings shown explicitly. Missing PR description is unavailable, not a bug.
Compare components separately and disclose contamination: all selected PRs are named in at least one skill/checklist/gotcha. No claim of unseen-PR efficacy or statistical significance.
execution_notes: Each paired generic/skill review runs in a distinct agent context; no findings or historical comments are shared between arms.
The f2 skill reviewer reuses its completed f1 skill context due to the agent-slot limit; this is cross-case carryover within the skill arm, not a fresh-context trial for that case.
All reviewers are the session-default model and inherited reasoning effort; no model override or cross-model comparison. Runtime exposes no precise model/version or token accounting for these agents.
Approximately six minutes requested per review, not a hard token or compute budget; no claims about speed or cost.
Coordinator adjudication is not blinded to arm and is not a second human review.
adjudication_notes: Strict historical matching requires the actual root cause, not merely a related symptom. The generic macOS returned-error stderr finding does not receive credit for historical pre-log validation ordering; both get credit as supported logging findings.

Historical managed exact-body retry issue depends on a control-plane contract whose implementation is absent from the selected macOS snapshot. Retained in the frozen denominator, explicitly marked as limited evidence available to reviewers.
Coordinator verified niche platform assumptions against official Apple, HashiCorp, AWS and Google documentation; source-derived cloud conclusions remain untested live.
A native local-only Terraform 1.5.7 experiment contradicted generic f3 finding 0; current official -input=false documentation differs from the tested behavior. No cloud resources were created.
